newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway November jobless rate lowest in eight years.
newsitem.headline: Norway November jobless rate lowest in eight years.

text.p: Norway's unemployment fell to 3.5 percent of the workforce in November, the lowest jobless rate since 1988, the Labour Directorate said on Thursday.
The rate dropped 0.1 percentage point from October and corresponded to 77,100 jobless.
Another 39,200, or 1.8 percent of the workforce, were part of government-run job and training schemes, a statement said.
Unemployment fell to 2.3 percent on an annual basis in 1988, which marked the end of a period of strong economic growth.
The Norwegian economy is currently booming partly as a result of rising oil production.
Fighting unemployment and keeping inflation down are among the main economic goals of the Labour minority government, which has proposed a tight 1997 budget with a surplus of 40.9 billion crowns.
